rationale: The Court is likely to resolve the case on a narrow statutory ground: under §1330(b), personal jurisdiction “shall exist” when an FSIA exception supplies subject-matter jurisdiction and service is made under §1608, without grafting an atextual minimum-contacts requirement. One or more concurrences (most likely Thomas and/or Gorsuch) may press the view that foreign sovereigns are not Fifth Amendment “persons,” while others may emphasize restraint and leave any constitutional question for a case that squarely requires it.
